The [[Cyrillian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cyrillia/Legends|Cyrillia]] began using floating [[Turbine/Legends|turbine]] powered '''transports''' on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] sometime prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[189 BBY]]. The species designed the [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droid]] in order to perform maintenance on the transports, including specifically jobs requiring small size, such as moving under hovering vehicles or climbing into circuitry bays.<ref name="NEGTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cyrillian transports were first mentioned in the DUM-series pit droid entry in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'', a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and released in [[2006]].
